bootstrap.design: hold-out policies resampled with replacement; fitted models held fixed; percentile 95% CI

refit.design: repeated stratified 70/30 splits with all models refitted; seeds 2027-2056

calibration.design: 5-fold cross-fitted out-of-fold training predictions used to estimate level-only and two-parameter log-linear Poisson recalibration maps; maps applied to main models' hold-out predictions; DF price rebuilt from recalibrated best-estimate model

adversarial_scenario.note: IAIS +1 on legal nature (binding via ICP adoption), accountability, fairness (paras 86-91) and oversight; NAIC -1 on legal nature and accountability; EU -1 on scope (horizontal, not insurance-specific). Ranking under this scenario: EU > IAIS > NAIC
